messages:
sara: Heads-up — planning a 90m workshop Wed Mar 8 10:00am PT to align on telemetry priorities for next quarter. Focus areas: dashboard templates, traces sampling strategy, error analysis UX, retention tiers and cost guardrails. Need eng, SRE, support, and design. Goal: decide top 3 deliverables and measurable KRs. React :thumbsup: if you can make it or suggest times.

dan: I can do Wed morning. If anyone needs Thu, say now. Also want to make sure we have cost model run before decisions.

li: +1. From eng side we need two things in scope: (1) migration path for trace index to support longer retention without query blowups, (2) an adaptive sampling prototype. Will bring an estimate.

morgan: For SRE: we want clear alerting signals tied to the dashboards. Proposed KR: reduce MTTR for customer-facing errors by 20% quarter-over-quarter. Also need SLI definitions in pre-read.

ev an: FYI customer ask — HelixHealth asked for 12mo full traces yesterday. They said compliance + audits. Not sure we can give full fidelity cheaply.

megan: I can design dashboard templates for the top 5 flows (signup, auth, inference, billing jobs, background workers). Need product to define acceptance criteria (what queries/filters must be present).

sara: Thanks. Quick agenda sketch attached below — please comment if you want other things on it. Also add any customer asks you want honored in the prioritization exercise.

Agenda (30s pre-reads):
- 10m: goals + constraints (cost, SLA, KR targets)
- 25m: customer asks & impact mapping (CS)
- 30m: technical feasibility + cost model (eng + SRE)
- 20m: tradeoff table + vote (product + design + eng)
- 5m: owners & next steps

li: Can we include a tiny config example for the adaptive sampling prototype so folks understand intent?

li: ```
# proto sampling cfg
mode: adaptive
target_coverage: 0.25 # keep ~25% of spans for high-volume services
burst_protection: true
priority_keys: [transaction, error]
```

morgan: Love the prototype. Also: retention tiers we should evaluate: default 7d, standard 90d, long 365d (enterprise opt-in). But need to show cost delta and query perf implications.

ev an: HelixHealth will push hard for 365d. We should surface cost + compliance tradeoffs in the meeting so CS has material to negotiate.

dan: I'll run a standing cost model by Tuesday — estimated storage + query cost delta for 90d vs 365d for median workload. Also will add perf numbers for trace index.

megan: UX ask: expose retention tier selection in Console -> Org Settings with clear billing note. I can wireframe after we pick tiers.

sara: Outcomes I want from the workshop: (A) agree top 3 deliverables, (B) owners + rough timelines, (C) KRs we can commit to for next quarter. Suggested deliverables: dashboard templates for top flows, adaptive sampling prototype + rollout plan, retention tiering + pricing.

morgan: +1 to that list, but ask we also include a lightweight tracing query optimization spike (2-week) as a dependency.

li: Agree — spike to confirm query latencies with 365d index. I'll scope that.

calendar-bot: Event created — "Telemetry Prioritization Workshop" Wed Mar 8 10:00am PDT — 90 minutes. Link: https://calendar.redwood/ev/2009991234

sara: Great. Action items before the workshop: (1) dan: cost model by Tue EOD, (2) li: spike scope + rough estimate, (3) megan: template examples and acceptance checklist, (4) evan: compile customer asks and priority ranking, (5) morgan: draft SLI/alert suggestions. Please drop docs into the shared folder: /r/obs-prio/q2-workshop.

evan: Will compile HelixHealth note + two other enterprise asks and upload by Monday.

dan: Cost model PR incoming Tue — will include storage, query ops, and per-request amortized cost.

megan: I'll do 2 sample mockups (web + small-screen) and a short note on discoverability.

li: Spike estimate: 1-2 engineers for 2 weeks to validate 365d index perf and a simple prototype for adaptive sampling.

morgan: SLI doc: will propose MTTR KR and error-rate buckets. Draft by Monday.

sara: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock the workshop Wed and we will publish the pre-read by Monday noon. Thanks everyone. :rocket:

megan: :thumbsup:

dan: :thumbsup:

sara: Post-workshop expected outputs (for the record):
- Decision: top 3 deliverables + commit to owners
- Prototype plan with milestone dates (alpha, beta, rollout)
- Retention tier definition + pricing proposal and customer negotiation playbook
- OKR-style KRs for telemetry that map back to MTTR, cost delta, and adoption metrics

li: Noted. I'll bring example telemetry queries we'll optimize during the spike.

morgan: Will coordinate with oncall to make sure any rollout has safe rollback and monitoring hooks.

calendar-bot: Reminder scheduled 24h before event.
